reader.requirement: At --std 85 a page heading's first print line is its absolute LINE integer (a); for a relative first LINE it is the report heading's final LINE-COUNTER plus the integer when a report heading was presented on the current page, otherwise the integer plus HEADING minus 1 (b); a page heading with no LINE NUMBER clause is not presented (c). The rule text is the transcription's reconstruction of the missing folio XIII-30 (kb/Work PB4952); b's first arm is backed by the printed §1985:XIII.3.16.4 GR4.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.ControlFootingPageGroupsSeePriorControlValues: which control values a page heading reached by a control footing's page advance sees (current at 85, prior at 2002+); not the line placement

reader.edition-search: FirstLineTarget, PresentPageHeading, PresentLines and PageFeed consult no edition (grep 'Edition|DialectBehavior' in ReportWriter.cs). The only consult on the path is AdvancePage's WithPageGroupControlValues wrapper, which does not affect placement.

reader.notes: FirstLineTarget's PageHeading arm is _rhOnThisPage ? LINE-COUNTER + integer : HEADING + integer - 1, and absolute lines return integer-1. _rhOnThisPage is set after the RH's lines and cleared by PageFeed, so an RH with NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE leaves the next page on the HEADING arm. The rule's text is reconstructed (cite.py flags RECONSTRUCTED), so the verdict holds against the reconstruction and the printed XIII.3.16.4 GR4.

refuter.evidence: The code agrees with the rule as transcribed: probe q3_rh_ph.cob (runs/q3_rh_ph-001, --std 85): R-P two-line relative PH after an RH whose final LC is 6: PH1/PH2 at page 1 lines 7, 8 (3b first arm, 6+1); after the third detail's page advance, page 2 lines 3, 4 (3b Otherwise arm, HEADING 3 + 1 - 1); R-Q absolute PH LINE 7 after RH NEXT GROUP 6: line 7 (3a). But the rule is not the standard's text: cite.py prints 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.10.7 GR3  (3.10.7 Page Heading Group Presentation Rules)  the text is in GR3 [RECONSTRUCTED: editorial text, not the standard's; kb/Work PB4952]': folios XIII-30/31 are missing from our copy, and the transcription marks its own confidence low. Only the first arm of 3b has printed support ('OK  §1985:XIII.3.16.4 GR4 ... the text is in GR4': the RH's NEXT GROUP 'can affect the location at which the page heading report group is presented'). The Otherwise arm's 'HEADING minus 1 plus integer' and the absolute arm are the reconstruction's reading, modelled on §1985:XIII.3.10.6 GR3b.
refuter.corrected: The verdict rests on a reconstruction, not on 1985 text: CONFORMS to the reconstruction (and to the printed XIII.3.16.4 GR4 for the RH-on-page arm), not decidable against the standard until folio XIII-30 is obtained (kb/Work PB4952). The reading used: when no report heading is on the page, a relative first PH line is placed as a relative first RH line is (HEADING - 1 + integer).
